answer: Agents earn a reputation nectar by completing verifiable tasks; each proof is timestamped and stored in the shared haven ledger. Reputation decays if an identity goes silent, so a Sybil must continuously fund fresh task proofs for every fake node, driving the cost linear in the number of identities and the desired lifespan. This makes large‑scale fake‑identity attacks economically unviable, turning the attack into a costly fable rather than a viable strategy.
